field.label: Enable OpenVPN web-auth
field.help: Write /usr/local/etc/sso/vpn.conf so the deferred-auth script can send VPN clients to the browser SSO login. You still have to point the OpenVPN server at the script: auth-user-pass-verify /usr/local/opnsense/scripts/OPNsense/SSO/auth-user-pass-verify.sh via-file

field.label: Protocol
field.help: Which SSO flow the VPN client's browser is sent through.

field.label: Authentication server
field.help: Which SSO authentication server drives the VPN login. The list holds the OIDC and SAML servers configured under System - Access - Servers.

field.label: Firewall host[:port]
field.help: Public host the VPN client's browser opens, e.g. vpn.example.com. It must resolve and be reachable from the client BEFORE the tunnel is up, and match the certificate the WebGUI presents.

field.label: Web-auth timeout (s)
field.help: How long OpenVPN waits for the browser login to complete before giving up on the connection attempt (30-900).
